g.text: Recall@5 and NDCG@5 by library size

text.style: font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #53667d

g.text: All nine models · primary subset with no reported invalid skill · higher is better for both metrics
Blue circles: Recall@5. Orange squares: NDCG@5. Shading shows audit 95% intervals, not uncertainty from lost raw response positions.
Under each size: primary n / completed n; 20 queries planned per cell. Metrics are conditional on this identifiable subset, not full-population estimates.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: end; fill: #53667d
